Package simple.file

package simple.file
  • Class
    Description
    CSV
    Utility class for handling CSV file operations such as reading CSV data, parsing CSV lines, and writing objects to CSV files.
    CSVFileNotFoundException
    Exception thrown when a specified CSV file is not found.
    CSVHeaderNotFoundException
    Exception thrown when a required CSV header is not found in the file.
    CSVRow
    Utility class to handle a single CSV row.
    FileUtils
    Utility class for handling file operations such as creating, moving, renaming, deleting, reading, and writing files and directories.
    InvalidCSVFileException
    Exception thrown when a CSV file is invalid.
    InvalidJSONFileException
    Exception thrown when a file is not a JSON file.
    JSON
    Utility class for handling JSON operations, including parsing files between CSV and JSON formats, serializing and deserializing objects, and reading and writing JSON data to and from files.
    JSONConversionException
    Exception thrown when an error occurs during JSON conversion processes.
    JSONFileNotFoundException
    Exception thrown when a specified JSON file is not found.
    JSONNodeNotFoundException
    Exception thrown when a specific JSON node cannot be found in a JSON file.
    Serialization
    A utility class for serializing and deserializing objects to and from files.
